items.claim: Anders Hylleberg sagde: 'We've had great discussions with our suppliers about how we can help drive more predictability for our industry to make the right decisions and investments to bring down the cost of offshore wind by 30 % over the next 10 years.'
items.source: Anders Hylleberg, Head of Offshore Procurement, Oersted, paa WindEnergy Hamburg

items.claim: Alana Kuehne sagde: 'For Oersted, WindEnergy Hamburg is about meeting with our suppliers and partners. By having these conversations now, we can better understand how their innovations can help shape the projects we have coming up over the next couple of years.'
items.source: Alana Kuehne, Head of Europe Development, Oersted

items.claim: Oersted markerede at havvindmoelleparken Barrow ud for den britiske Cumbria-kyst har vaeret i kommerciel drift i 20 aar, og beskrev den 90 MW store park med 30 Vestas-moeller som en af Storbritanniens foerste kommercielle havvindmoelleparker.

Godson Njoku sagde: 'Twenty years ago, Barrow was part of a pioneering generation of offshore wind projects that showed what could be achieved by taking turbines out to sea and harnessing the UK's abundant wind resource.'
items.source: Godson Njoku, Chief Generation Officer, Oersted

items.claim: Efter det andet møllevingesvigt på to måneder på Greater Changhua 4 (583 MW) i Taiwan bekræftede Ørsted at hændelsen indtraf "around noon on Friday", og at "no personnel were working on the turbine at the time"; en talsperson for Ørsted udtalte at "blade failures of this nature are highly unusual across our offshore fleet" og at det var "premature to draw conclusions" før den tekniske analyse er færdig, og selskabet oplyste at det undersøger årsagen sammen med møllefabrikanten Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy.
items.source: Talsperson for Ørsted, citeret af RenewEconomy

items.claim: ad-hoc-news refererede Ørsteds meddelelse af 22. september 2026 om Borkum Riffgrund 3, hvor selskabet oplyste at anlægget "can produce enough renewable electricity for close to one million German households", at det er Ørsteds sjette havvindmøllepark i drift i Tyskland, og at det bringer Ørsteds installerede tyske havvindkapacitet til 2,50 GW.
